name: Cislunar-Moulin

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by dead riverbeds and dry ocean basins and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the ancient alien ruins left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
There is money in iron, platinum and silicon and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
